#include "ara/per/file_storage.h"
Description:
Recovers a file of this file storage.
This method allows to recover a single file when the redundancy checks fail. It will fail with a k
ResourceBusyError when the file is currently open.
This method does a best-effort recovery of the file. After recovery, the file might show outdated
or initial content, or might be lost.
